title: Delete the old store layer (P62.1)
extra:
Epic 1.0.0 of easy-review (repo VilfredSikker/easy-review), release branch release/v1.0.0. Plans: docs/epics/1.0.0/PLAN.md, ADDENDUM-06-phase-5.md (desktop protocol), ADDENDUM-07-phase-5b.md (TUI). Read the merged PR bodies of earlier items and the item issue's comments for deviations and coordinator decisions. Heavy checks run one at a time, sandbox off, through ~/.claude/scripts/epic-run.sh <dir> ~/.claude/scripts/locked.sh <dir> just <gate>, under a temp HOME; afterwards the temp HOME must hold no Library/Application Support/easy-review/v1/app. desktop-ui gates (lint-ui, test-ui, check-ui with one known error in src/main.ts) need desktop-ui/node_modules symlinked and bun on PATH: /Users/vilfredsikker/.local/share/mise/installs/bun/1.4.4/bin first, via a scratch script run as epic-run.sh <dir> bash <script>. Stop line 1,500 counted lines per PR (added plus changed after rename detection). Known flaky test projects::tests::a_pin_landing_during_a_desktop_update_survives (#630): name it if it fails, never change it. Never rebase or force-push. Commit with plain git outside epic-run.sh (its temp HOME can drop the signature silently); if signing fails, retry twice over two minutes; if it still fails, follow the RULES fallback (commit unsigned, say so in the PR body) and report it. Push with the sandbox off, written exactly: cd <dir> && git push origin <branch>. gh with the sandbox off, one command per call. Never read or write ~/Library/Application Support/easy-review. Post questions on the item issue and return status "decision" if blocked; do not SendMessage the coordinator. Owner go-ahead: on 2026-11-22 the owner set the goal "implement phase 5 fully"; the coordinator runs the remaining phase-5 items (P56.2 to P62.2) in dependency order.

P62.1 BUILD (phase 5). Every dependency is merged except P60.2b: P53–P59, P60.1 (#694–#696, #699, #700), P60.2a (#701, #702) and P61 (#697, #698) are in release. P60.2b (triage, agent commands, logs, background tasks and the tick's App duties on jobs) is building beside you in clone p60d on epic/p60c-jobs-triage-tasks; it adds desktop-ui adapters and backend arms of its own. Build everything else now. Before you open your final PRs, fetch: if P60.2b has merged into release, merge release in and delete its flag-off branches too; if it has not, open the PRs anyway and say in the body which P60.2b pieces still need the same deletion (the coordinator then runs a catch-up). The test change is stated in the entry: P38's default-build assertion flips, test-desktop runs the flag-on path. Rulings so far are on #612, #614–#616, #618–#620; read them. Deletions do not count toward the stop line, but a PR over 1,500 counted lines still splits. Branch from origin/release/v1.0.0 in a new clone /Users/vilfredsikker/.claude-worktrees/er-v1/p62a (git clone --quiet /Users/vilfredsikker/Projects/easy-review <dir>, set origin to https://github.com/VilfredSikker/easy-review.git, fetch). Before building, re-verify the entry's citations against origin/release/v1.0.0 and post corrections on #621. Use the entry's fallback split as stacked PRs if over 1,500. Merge origin/release/v1.0.0 in before opening PRs.
review_focus:
Item P62.1 (#621), phase 5. The ADDENDUM-06 entry is the spec:
### P62.1 Delete the old store layer

- Branch: `epic/p62a-delete-old-store-layer`. Lanes: U, P, C, D. Model: `opus`. Depends on: P53, P54, P55.1, P55.2, P55.3, P56.1, P56.2, P56.3, P57, P58.1, P58.2, P59, P60.1, P60.2, P61.
- **Goal:** desktop-ui runs only on resources.
- **Done when:** the adapters lose their flag-off branch; the `snapshot` store, `poll` handling, `optimisticLocal.ts`'s remainder, `snapshotDelta.ts`, `snapshotChrome.ts`, `tabSnapshotCache.ts` and `v1ServiceFlag.ts` are deleted; the hand-written `types.ts` is replaced by a generated barrel that `protocol-check` covers, and frontend-only types move to their modules; `scripts/tauri-dev.sh` drops the flag; er-desktop makes `v1-service` a default feature, so a backend built without it cannot pair with the new frontend. **Test change, up front:** P38's default-build assertion in the bin target (`!cfg!(feature = "v1-service")`, `crates/er-desktop/src/main.rs:2388`) flips to assert the feature is on, and from here `test-desktop` runs the flag-on path, which makes `test-v1` redundant for er-desktop; the flag-off backend tests compile out with their `cfg`.
- **Planted breaks:** a hand edit of `types.ts` fails `protocol-check`; a component reading `app.snapshot` fails the source scan; `check-ui` fails on a removed field still referenced; running `cargo test -p er-desktop --bin er-desktop --no-default-features` fails the flipped assertion (a build alone runs no assertion).
- Size: M (deletions do not count).

Check: every done-when item exists and each planted break fails; flag-off unchanged; new commands satisfy er::command_shape and its allow-list only shrinks; source scans hold; History, Conflicts and Hidden keep the snapshot fallback until P56.3; each PR under 1,500.
